acceptance.given: Validator Capability evaluation is prepared with a current candidate and an authority-path trust-envelope input.

oracle.expected: Before evaluation, the existing authority path emits a candidate-external trust envelope whose canonical record contains validator content identity, the complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope; evaluation accepts it only when every required member is present, unambiguous, and unchanged.
forbidden: The Candidate change set creates, selects, or controls the trust envelope.
Evaluation starts without a pre-evaluation frozen trust envelope.
A missing, ambiguous, or changed validator, dependency, support-policy, or scope member is accepted as valid.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt and persisted envelope record show the frozen validator content, complete dependency identities, support policy, scope, authority provenance, and pre-evaluation timestamp/order; mutating, removing, or ambiguously duplicating any member causes deterministic validation rejection before evaluation.

acceptance.then: The trust envelope is frozen and verified before any candidate evaluation process executes.
acceptance.when: Prepare and execute Validator Capability evaluation, then repeat with each envelope member removed, duplicated ambiguously, or content/dependency/policy/scope changed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove the pre-evaluation trust-envelope artifact and assert that evaluation refuses to start.
Make the candidate change set supply or alter the envelope authority/content and assert candidate-external trust validation rejects it.
Delete, ambiguously duplicate, or mutate one validator-content, semantic-dependency, support-policy, or scope member and assert the envelope is invalidated before evaluation.

affected_subjects: Validator trust envelope lifecycle and pre-evaluation Semantic Dependency binding
slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain replay authority path construct and freeze a candidate-external trust envelope containing validator content, complete Semantic Dependency identities, support policy, and scope, and fail closed before evaluation when any member is missing, ambiguous, or changed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay route and receipt compatibility; rollback restores prior envelope validation behavior while retaining append-only evidence and rejecting candidate-controlled authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: No evaluation may transition to running until a frozen, candidate-external, closure-complete trust envelope is independently verified; any member drift transitions the attempt to deterministic rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Evaluation reaches a terminal rejected state with an explicit trust-envelope invalidation reason whenever the envelope is absent, candidate-controlled, incomplete, ambiguous, or changed; only a complete unchanged envelope permits evaluation to proceed.
